# Cyber Kings (2026-11-17): Hegemonic Ambitions. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_ambitions.py - change the generator, not this file.
namespace = ck_ambition

# terra: the ambition becomes possible (players)
ck_ambition.101 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.101.t
	desc = ck_ambition.101.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.101.a
		trigger = { prestige >= ck_ambition_cost_terra }
		add_prestige = { value = ck_ambition_cost_terra multiply = -1 }
		ck_ambition_declare_effect = { G = terra NOTIFY = ck_ambition.102 RIVAL = ck_ambition.103 RIVAL_SELF = ck_ambition.104 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.101.b
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_later_tt
	}
}

# terra: milestone 75%
ck_ambition.110 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.110.t
	desc = ck_ambition.110.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.110.a
		trigger = { gold >= 150 }
		add_gold = -150
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_proclamation_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = gregarious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.110.b
		trigger = { prestige >= 200 }
		add_prestige = -200
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_war_machine_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = wrathful }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_education_martial_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.110.c
		add_prestige = -100
		ck_ambition_reassure_effect = yes
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_reassure_tt
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = diplomat }
		}
	}
}

# terra: milestone 90%
ck_ambition.111 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.111.t
	desc = ck_ambition.111.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.111.a
		random_county_in_region = { region = ckworld_earth
			limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
				any_neighboring_county = { holder.top_liege ?= root }
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_claim
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ck_amb_claim }
			add_pressed_claim = scope:ck_amb_claim
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = ambitious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.111.b
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 300 }
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.111.c
		add_prestige = 300
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
}

	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.120.t
	desc = ck_ambition.120.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	immediate = {
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = terra }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_realized_modifier years = 25 }
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 500 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.120.a
	}
}

ck_ambition.510 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.510.t
	desc = ck_ambition.510.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.510.a
		trigger = { gold >= 150 }
		add_gold = -150
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_proclamation_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = gregarious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.510.b
		trigger = { prestige >= 200 }
		add_prestige = -200
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_war_machine_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = wrathful }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_education_martial_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.510.c
		add_prestige = -100
		ck_ambition_reassure_effect = yes
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_reassure_tt
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = diplomat }
		}
	}
}

# eurasia: milestone 90%
ck_ambition.511 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.511.t
	desc = ck_ambition.511.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.511.a
		title:h_eurasia = { random_de_jure_county = {
			limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
				any_neighboring_county = { holder.top_liege ?= root }
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_claim
		} }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ck_amb_claim }
			add_pressed_claim = scope:ck_amb_claim
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = ambitious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.511.b
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 300 }
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.511.c
		add_prestige = 300
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
}

# venus: milestone 75%
ck_ambition.810 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.810.t
	desc = ck_ambition.810.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.810.a
		trigger = { gold >= 150 }
		add_gold = -150
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_proclamation_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = gregarious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.810.b
		trigger = { prestige >= 200 }
		add_prestige = -200
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_war_machine_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = wrathful }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_education_martial_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.810.c
		add_prestige = -100
		ck_ambition_reassure_effect = yes
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_reassure_tt
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = diplomat }
		}
	}
}

# venus: milestone 90%
ck_ambition.811 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.811.t
	desc = ck_ambition.811.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.811.a
		title:h_venus = { random_de_jure_county = {
			limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
				any_neighboring_county = { holder.top_liege ?= root }
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_claim
		} }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ck_amb_claim }
			add_pressed_claim = scope:ck_amb_claim
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = ambitious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.811.b
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 300 }
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.811.c
		add_prestige = 300
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
}

	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.820.t
	desc = ck_ambition.820.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	immediate = {
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = venus }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_realized_modifier years = 25 }
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 500 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.820.a
	}
}

	desc = ck_ambition.821.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	immediate = {
		ck_ambition_end_effect = { G = venus }

		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_thwarted_modifier years = 10 }
		stress_impact = { ambitious = medium_stress_impact_gain arrogant = minor_stress_impact_gain }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.821.a
	}

	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.901.t
	desc = ck_ambition.901.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.901.a
		trigger = { prestige >= ck_ambition_cost_mars }
		add_prestige = { value = ck_ambition_cost_mars multiply = -1 }
		ck_ambition_declare_effect = { G = mars NOTIFY = ck_ambition.902 RIVAL = ck_ambition.903 RIVAL_SELF = ck_ambition.904 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.901.b
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_later_tt
	}
}

		name = ck_ambition.1112.a
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition.1112.tt
	}
}

# galilean: the ambition becomes possible (players)
ck_ambition.1201 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.1201.t
	desc = ck_ambition.1201.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1201.a
		trigger = { prestige >= ck_ambition_cost_galilean }
		add_prestige = { value = ck_ambition_cost_galilean multiply = -1 }
		ck_ambition_declare_effect = { G = galilean NOTIFY = ck_ambition.1202 RIVAL = ck_ambition.1203 RIVAL_SELF = ck_ambition.1204 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1201.b
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_later_tt
	}
}

# galilean: milestone 75%
ck_ambition.1210 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.1210.t
	desc = ck_ambition.1210.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1210.a
		trigger = { gold >= 150 }
		add_gold = -150
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_proclamation_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = gregarious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1210.b
		trigger = { prestige >= 200 }
		add_prestige = -200
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_war_machine_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = wrathful }
			modifier = { add = 20 has_education_martial_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1210.c
		add_prestige = -100
		ck_ambition_reassure_effect = yes
		custom_tooltip = ck_ambition_reassure_tt
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { add = 20 has_trait = diplomat }
		}
	}
}

# galilean: milestone 90%
ck_ambition.1211 = {
	type = character_event
	title = ck_ambition.1211.t
	desc = ck_ambition.1211.desc
	theme = realm
	left_portrait = root
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1211.a
		title:h_galilean = { random_de_jure_county = {
			limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
				any_neighboring_county = { holder.top_liege ?= root }
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				exists = holder
				NOT = { holder.top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = ck_amb_claim
		} }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ck_amb_claim }
			add_pressed_claim = scope:ck_amb_claim
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = ambitious }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1211.b
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = 300 }
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
	option = {
		name = ck_ambition.1211.c
		add_prestige = 300
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}
}
